lines.text: Need a simple snack for the table? Meet Crown Almond Biscuits, ready to share.
lines.delivery: Warm off-camera voice; open conversationally, then brighten on the product name.

lines.delivery: A little slower and demonstrative, letting the break and milk action provide the emphasis.

lines.text: Put a few out to share, and come give Crown Almond Biscuits a try.
